text: Marketers can build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI once the schema is configured
quote: Once the schema is configured, marketers can build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI.

text: Data teams create models by writing SQL, selecting tables or views, or reusing dbt models and Looker or Sigma queries
quote: Data teams typically create models by writing SQL in the editor, selecting from tables or views, or re-using dbt models and BI queries from Looker or Sigma.

text: Reusable models can also be defined with a visual builder
quote: Models — Define reusable datasets with SQL, dbt, or a visual builder

text: Connects to any data warehouse, lake, or other source, and defines records to sync by selecting a table or writing SQL
quote: Connect to any data warehouse, lake, or other source. Define the records to sync by selecting a table or writing SQL.

text: Runs on top of your data warehouse, so customer data is used without copying it into a separate system
quote: Hightouch runs on top of your data warehouse, so teams use their existing customer data without copying it into a separate system.

text: Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on top of resolved identities in the warehouse
quote: If you're coming from a tool that stored and served customer profiles for you, this is the largest shift to plan for. The logic that lived in that tool moves to your warehouse: Identity Resolution unifies a person's identifiers into one res

text: Syncs run on a schedule or trigger you set and report the outcome of each run
quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.

text: Syncs send modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes
quote: Sync modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes.

text: Syncs to 300+ destinations, either in real time or on a recurring schedule
quote: Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule. Spin up new data pipelines in minutes — not weeks.

text: Each sync maps a model's rows to one destination object, list, or table
quote: A sync connects one model to one destination object, list, or table, and describes how the model's rows map into that destination.

text: Syncs can insert, update, or upsert records in the destination object
quote: **Sync type and mode** — the destination object to write to and whether to insert, update, or upsert records.

text: Change data capture sends only the rows that were added, changed, or removed since the previous run
quote: Hightouch uses change data capture to compare the current model results against the previous run and send only the rows that were added, changed, or removed.

text: The Lightning sync engine computes CDC directly in the warehouse for higher performance at scale
quote: For higher performance at scale, you can enable the Lightning sync engine to compute CDC directly in the warehouse.

text: A sync debugger lets you check runs and debug rejected rows
quote: Check a run or debug rejected rows | Debug a sync run

text: Sync alerts notify you when a run fails
quote:
Get notified when a run fails

[Configure sync alerts]

text: Syncs can be configured in the app or controlled via the API
quote: Map fields between your source and destination. Configure syncs in the app or take control via API.

text: Build your own custom destination, often without writing code
quote: Build your own custom destination in minutes—often without writing a single line of code.

text: Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems and stores it in your warehouse
quote: Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems, then stores that data in your warehouse.

text: Event SDKs are available for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js, and other platforms
quote: Hightouch provides SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js, and other platforms, plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion

text: Supports five event types: identify, track, page, screen, and group
quote: Events come in five types — identify, track, page, screen, and group — each for a different kind of action.

text: An HTTP Tracking API records data from any website or application for server-side ingestion
quote: Hightouch's HTTP Tracking API enables you to record data from any website or application.

text: A batch endpoint submits multiple events to the collector in a single request
quote: Use the batch endpoint to submit multiple events to the collector in a single request.

text: Events can be ingested from streaming sources such as Kafka or Google Pub/Sub
quote: You instrument your app, site, or backend with a Hightouch SDK, the HTTP API, or a streaming source like Kafka or Google Pub/Sub.

text: Data contracts ensure that only approved, standardized event data is collected
quote: Establish proactive data contracts so that Hightouch only collects approved, standardized data.

text: Identity Resolution links customer records across devices and channels into unified identities in the warehouse
quote: Resolve identities across devices and channels so teams can build on a more complete customer record.

text: A Golden Record table holds one row per identity, with canonical field values chosen by survivorship rules
quote: Golden Record — a one-row-per-identity table of canonical field values (selected by survivorship rules) that many teams use as their source-of-truth customer or account view.

text: Match booster adds identifiers such as emails, phones, mobile IDs, and addresses to ad platform audiences and conversions
quote: Match booster enabled, expanding identifiers to include a user's personal email, phone number, work email, mobile IDs, and address data.

text: An official MCP server lets AI assistants build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate content, and analyze performance
quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.

text: Through MCP, all customers can explore the schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, and manage or template syncs
quote: All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.

text: A natural-language prompt can create an audience and set up a sync to a destination such as Braze
quote: "Create an audience of customers that added an item to their cart in the last day but haven't completed a transaction, then create a sync to Braze."

text: Campaign performance, such as conversions by email campaign, can be analyzed with natural-language questions
quote: "Show me which email campaigns drove the most conversions last quarter, and how did they perform compared to the quarter before?"

text: A built-in agent explores segments and analyzes campaign performance in natural language
quote: Create audiences from warehouse data, build automated journeys, and use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language.

text: Ad Studio generates visual ad creatives from a prompt, refines them with follow-ups, and lets you browse existing projects
quote: Ad Studio Customers: Generate visual ad creatives from a prompt, refine them with follow-up instructions, and browse existing projects.

text: AI turns existing approved assets into new variations for lifecycle and paid campaigns
quote: Quickly turn existing, approved assets for lifecycle and paid campaigns into new variations, no design tickets required.

text: AI searches existing content before creating anything new, to keep the brand consistent
quote: Ensure brand consistency by using AI to search across your existing content before creating anything new.

text: AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to pick the best message, channel, and timing per customer and measure results
quote: AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing for each customer, then measures what worked.

text: Decisioning agents combine an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails
quote: The core unit is an agent. Each agent combines everything a campaign needs to learn and improve: an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails.

text: Marketers guide, review, and refine the AI agents' work before anything launches
quote: Marketers guide, review, and refine the agents’ work before anything launches.

text: Website and app experiences can be personalized in real time based on current customer behavior
quote: Tailor website and app experiences based on what a customer is doing right now.

text: Hightouch can send email, SMS, and push directly, or deliver audiences and content to existing ESPs and ad platforms
quote: When campaigns are ready, Hightouch can send email, SMS, and push messages directly, or deliver audiences and content to the ESPs and ad platforms you already use.

text: A public REST API lets users work with syncs, models, sources, and destinations
quote: Hightouch exposes a REST API that lets users interact with resources like syncs, models, sources, and destinations.

text: A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec is published and used to render the API reference
quote: Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at api.hightouch.io/api/swagger.json: info.title "Hightouch API", description "Hightouch Public Rest API to access syncs, models, sources and destinations", 36 documented paths,

text: The API docs let you enter an API key, fill in parameters, and send requests to see live responses
quote: Enter your API key, fill in the parameters, and send the request to see the live response.

text: The API uses bearer-token API keys, a documented limit of 200 requests per 10 seconds per workspace, and TLS 1.2+
quote: API guide: "Append the endpoint path to the base URL. For example, to list syncs, send a request to https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1/syncs. Authenticate each request by passing your API key as a bearer token in the Authorization header"; "T

text: API keys can be scoped to a group, for example a viewer role for an AI tool, to avoid granting admin access
quote: Scope a key to a group to keep it from having admin access. For example, an AI tool can use a key scoped to a group with the Workspace viewer role.

text: Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically
quote: Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically.

text: Permissions, approvals, and ownership boundaries control each team's level of access
quote: Set up permissions, approvals, and ownership boundaries so each team has the right level of access.

text: Rules govern which users can access which data, and where and how that data can be used
quote: Set robust rules to manage which users can access which data, and where and how that data can get used.

text: PHI data can be synced from the warehouse to HIPAA-compliant destinations
quote: Safely sync PHI data from your warehouse to HIPAA-compliant destinations.

text: The free tier includes up to 2 active syncs, with unlimited destinations and user seats
quote:
Up to 2 active syncs
*   Unlimited destination count
*   Unlimited user seats
